title: Ultra Lite Shadows
description: A high performence and low-end/potato pc friendly shader pack.
body:
# Works even on an low end pc

![With and Without Ultra Lite Shadows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97c8a127c99d24ab816032c6aba1210930723ff2.png)
### Features
- True Cave Shadows: Adds depth and darkness to underground areas.
- Warm Amber Torchlight: Custom light math that creates cozy, natural interiors without overexposing your screen.
- Potato-PC Optimized: Engineered to run smoothly on integrated graphics (50+ FPS).

### Requirements
- Requires Iris"
